properties.Name: Colmeia 62
properties.Description: Colmeia 62 is a diverse group of individuals hailing from various corners of the globe, spanning multiple generations, professional domains and belief systems. Yet, it is precisely these dissimilarities that bind them together and make them whole.They share a deep-seated passion for fostering human and environmental connections, and as such, they are fervently working towards the creation of a community that embodies simplicity and humanity.

properties.Name: Avnø Oasis
properties.Description: Avnø Oasis is an aspiring ecovillage open to new members. Once it is fully developed it will have 3 legs: An intentional community, Avnø Højskole (a residential adult educational center) and several regenerative enterprises and green projects. Avnø højskole is gaining momentum and is on a regular basis offering courses of 1-12 weeks duration on health, happiness, green living, ecovillage design, permaculture, sociocracy etc. Our intentional community is growing and green projects and enterprises are on the sprouting stage.

properties.Name: Vidàlia
properties.Description: The Vidalia project is an intentional community located in the old textile mill town of Cal Vidal (Puig-reig, Barcelona). Their legal structure is a housing cooperative and a 75 years contract of Masoveria Urbana (work for rent). They currently are made up of 21 adults and 8 kids. They aim for a social and solidarity economy that is local, biological and agroecological. Their autonomy and membership framework is based on sociocracy 3.0. Sustainability and degrowth is promoted through renewable energy and efficient technologies. Creativity and communication is nourished through empathic communication, embodiment, and artistic forms of expression.

properties.Name: Burg Disternich
properties.Description: Burg Disternich is a group of 10 adults and 4 children living in Disternich Castle. Their non-profit organisation BurgOase e.V. focuses on cultural, nature-related and educational work. The non profit aims to enable identity forming experiences and moments of self efficacy for people of all ages. A socio-cultural centre for seminars and workshops is currently built for this purpose. They aim to promote regional cultural work, music, young talent, and creating various events. They cooperate and network with local and regional players from civil society, politics and business so that new and low-threshold offers can be created in the rural region.

properties.Name: Jánoshida
properties.Description: The Jánoshida project, Hungary, is a model for a sustainable, caring, elderly friendly, organic, and regenerative future. The Municipality of Jánoshida and Hekate Conscious Ageing Foundation worked out a joint vision and a cooperation framework called JANOSHIDA2030, in order to further develop the already significant elderly-care related services of the village. Their joint aim is to create a European model of elderly-friendly and environmentally sustainable modern settlements.

properties.Name: Living Home Ukraine
properties.Description: The ecovillage is situated in the 60 km from Kharkiv region an consists of 9 adults and two children, and they are specialising in the permaculture, ceramics, beehives and eco-tourism. They are NGO "Living Home Ukraine". They have 3 hectares of land, big Crater Garden made after the seminar of Sepp Holzer, many interesting locations, beehive House, two lakes and other. They accept volunteers, make a lot of social projects, events and are are member of GEN Ukraine and Permaculture network.

properties.Name: Ananda Kalyani
properties.Description:
Ananda Kalyani is a pioneering Integrated Rural Development (IRD) project of Ananda Marga dedicated to spirituality, local development, and holistic regeneration, encompassing environmental, economic, and social aspects. Our aim is to serve as a model and educational hub for sustainable and regenerative living in the 21st century.
Nestled in the heart of Portugal, near the Serra da Estrela Natural Reserve, Ananda Kalyani has been transformed from a lush, abandoned valley into a vibrant, habitable space over the past few years. We work in collaboration with several organizations such as EcoAtivo (Ecology & Environment), ARTivos (Art & Culture), PRIP (Economy & Politics), Pequena Ilha Verde (Education), and Amurt (Humanitarian Aid) to create thriving projects, events, and partnerships.
Our property spans 50 hectares, featuring wild forests, a picturesque river, scattered ruins, small springs, and wild fruit trees, along with 11 hectares of certified organic agricultural land. We offer camping and caravan spaces, Casa & Praça Dharma – our activity hall, dining area, and dormitory, Dhyana Mandir – our meditation yurt, and outdoor facilities including sawdust toilets and hot showers. With the newly built Guest House, our place has become even more comfortable for visitors who appreciate modern amenities.
In 2010, we set out to find land in Serra da Estrela to establish an Ananda Marga Master Unit in Portugal. Our vision was to create a model for integrated development and a community for collective spiritual practice, self-realization, and service to all beings. Over the past years, this vision has evolved into Ananda Kalyani, a recognized GEN European ecovillage and Erasmus+ Partner. We now host youth exchanges, training courses, events, workshops, and retreats, fostering deep connections with a variety of regenerative and conscious networks.

Vision
A safe and vibrant settlement rooted in conscious, all-round sustainability – spiritual, social, economic, and environmental – acting as a service, research, and learning center. Ananda Kalyani provides a journey from a holistic perspective, where individuals, by moving together in harmony with nature and the surrounding community, can realize their full inner potential and outward actions.

Mission
To create a way of living and learning within an inclusive environment in harmony with nature. Our focus areas include:
Deep ecology and sustainable agriculture
Vegetarianism and conscious nutrition
Education and life-long learning
Spirituality and self-realization
Social service and activism
These elements serve as tools for conscious regenerative sustainability.

Membership & Visitors
Current members: 50
Open to new members: Yes
Open to visitors: Yes

properties.Name: ThinkCamp gem. eG
properties.Description: The UnaVision community lives on Gut Herzershof 90 km east of Berlin Germany. We acquired the former farm in 2018 and renovated it to serve as a learning and experimental location for sustainable working, learning and living. We foster a biodiverse garden for our own food needs. We eat vegetarian.

properties.Name: Earthbound Ecovillage
properties.Description: Earthbound is an upcoming ecovillage and think tank for rural community- and regenerative living in Southern Sweden. We are creating a community of 30 people stewarding 73 ha of land with a lake, ancient forest and 9 buildings.

properties.Name: Essência
properties.Description:
Essência is an off-grid eco-village, healing center, and retreat venue by the coast of Portugal. 
We are a community of people who believe life can be lived differently — slower, closer to nature, and more connected to ourselves, each other, and the Earth. Some people come to rest, heal and reconnect. 
Some people are called to our retreats, gatherings and regenerative events. Other are called to co-create, learn and share with us. All of you are welcome!

properties.Name: Gaia Terra
properties.Description:
Discover Gaia Terra, a vibrant intentional community in Northern Italy born from a 115-year-old factory! Nestled by the Stella River, we champion societal renewal through balance, equality, and free expression.

We thrive on organic vegan food, permaculture, eco-building, workshops, events, and clear waters via phytodepuration. Join our active volunteers or become a long-term resident to grow our core community. Step into nature and join our movement!

properties.Name: Traditional Dream Factory
properties.Description:
TDF is a regenerative village on 25 hectares near Abela, in Portugal’s Alentejo. It was the first village of OASA, a Swiss non-profit association that buys land and holds it in common, so it stays out of the private property market for good. Daily life runs through Closer, a platform built for regenerative villages, where people book stays, join events and take part in governance.
Members join by buying $TDF tokens. These give access to the land and its buildings, and they’re also how decisions get made: holding tokens means having a say in how the village grows. Over 60 citizens co-steward TDF this way. On the land we practise regenerative agriculture and are building co-housing, a co-living and a restaurant. You can come for a stay in our treehouse, van, glamping tents or camp, volunteer with us, or join one of the workshops, gatherings and residencies we host through the year.
